title: Graves, letters, lanterns and a crown
changes: New quests The Empty Grave in Gravemoor Cemetery (level 15) and Two Letters from Old Garrick, after the Redfang Chief: dig the right grave, then choose who gets a letter. Your choice changes who trades with you.

New quest The Last Lantern (level 10, Brother Aldric): carry the last spirit lantern from Misty Marsh to Saint Elow's shrine in Brinewood. Water, night and setting it down dim it, and blobs follow the light.
New quest Hold the Wheel (level 4, Odo the miller): stay close and keep the blobs off Odo for 90 seconds, then face the Millrace Glutton.
New quest The Crown in the Sand in Kharsun (levels 38 to 39): a crowned seal in the desert leads to Ostrevar's Envoy.
